comparison.objective: Cock a desoldering pump, seat its nozzle on a marked joint, fire it, and return it to its holster; distinct from damper commissioning.
comparison.physical_skill: Spring loading until latch engagement, nozzle alignment, bimanual stabilization/button pressing, recoil control, and reholstering versus setscrew/collar manipulation.
comparison.success_condition: Pump must be cocked, fired on the marked joint while held upright, then holstered; off-joint firing wastes the shot. Numeric alignment and force thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: Bimanual holding and latching overlap only at a generic level; the tested spring-tool sequence differs from iterative damping adjustment.
